name: thirdweb legacy Bridge approval misuse
summary: The legacy thirdweb Bridge implementation executed a caller-chosen forward call from the bridge's own context after 'collecting' a caller-chosen token. With a codeless fake token the collection was a no-op and the forward call was USDC.transferFrom(victim, attacker), spending wallets' standing approvals to the bridge.
notes: The proxy was created already pointing at the vulnerable implementation, so its creation is the reset; the implementation's own earlier deployment ran in no system before that. The only later Upgraded event is the fix, after the last campaign transaction.

Campaign includes an unaffiliated MEV bot that copied the call through its own contract, besides the original attacker's later repeats; no rescue or third-party pull exists before the anchor or on other chains where the proxy address is deployed.
